data.title: 埃塔 · 深夜实验后的奖励
data.description: 实验室只亮着一盏灯。埃塔趴在图纸上睡了一会儿，醒来时睡衣已滑落在桌边。她揉揉眼睛，睡眼朦胧地靠着实验台，让手指缓缓探向腿间，决定先给自己一点奖励。
data.location: 阴影庭园地下实验室·深夜
data.action: 独自在实验台旁醒来，睡衣滑落，睡眼朦胧地靠着图纸，指尖探向腿间
data.lighting: single lab lamp and sleeping monitors glow
data.promptProse: Alone under the lab lamp, adult Eta wakes beside her blueprints with her pajamas slipped off, resting against the drafting table with sleepy eyes and one hand between her thighs.
data.animaCaption: Eta wakes slowly beside the scattered blueprints.
